snippet.title: D-BEAT HEROES - Official Demo Trailer | Indie Quest 2026
snippet.description:
Try DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531890/DBEAT_HEROES/

D-BEAT HEROES is a grid-based tag-team action RPG! Choose powerful abilities to take with you into combat and fight against your enemies on the grid! Protect Daylight City from the forces of evil and maintain order. Do it before it's too late! 

Developer: jqtran.dev
X: https://x.com/dbh_project
